cards.design_implication: Implement 'snake' voltage scan patterns and monitor leakage currents strictly (e.g., < 5 pA) to ensure the system remains in equilibrium with electrodes during thermodynamic measurements.
does_not_establish: Equilibrium in low-doping regimes where hysteresis was observed in contact regions.
Time scales for equilibration in devices with different contact resistances.
cards.evidence_excerpt: It is also taken as a “snake” scan, and we do not observe any hysteresis down to mV level, indicating our system is in equilibrium with the contact.
limitations: Equilibrium assurance is specific to the device geometry and doping levels described.
Hysteresis detection threshold was down to mV level.
cards.statement: Equilibrium conditions were verified by maintaining leakage current below 5 pA and performing 'snake' scans with no observed hysteresis down to the mV level at high vertical electric field.
